Criteria:
- P1: Dependencies: does every step come after the steps whose results it needs? If a requirement of step B uses something that a requirement of step A creates (a name, a command, a connection, data, a schema, a part that is reused), B needs A. Name each missing dependency as 'A -> B' (A must finish before B) and say what B needs from A.
- P2: Coverage: is each requirement's work done by build and test steps that really do it?
- P3: Acceptance criteria: are they concrete and checkable?
- P4: Granularity: no duplicated steps and no step split into trivial pieces?

The research, verify, design and review steps and the order research -> design -> build -> test -> documents -> review come from a template and are correct. Steps listed as 'after: X' already depend on X (directly); a dependency through other steps also counts.

Material:
Requirements:
R1 [must] The dashboard must read the CSV files that the stations produce.
R2 [must] It must show a line chart of temperature for any chosen day.
R3 [should] Users should be able to compare two stations on the same chart.
R4 [must] The dashboard must flag readings that are missing for more than one hour.
R5 [must] The dashboard must open in under five seconds for one month of data.

Plan steps:
research [research] Research the approach (requirements: -; after: -) criteria: every research question has an answer with sources; the answers name the options considered
verify [research] Check the research findings (requirements: -; after: research) criteria: every claim the design uses is supported by a source; unsupported claims are marked
design [design] Design the solution (requirements: -; after: verify) criteria: each part has a module and an interface; the skeleton runs; the design follows the constraints; C1 respected: Use Python with pandas and matplotlib or Plotly.
T1 [implement] Implement: The dashboard must read the CSV files that the… (+2) (requirements: R1, R2, R3; after: design) criteria: R1: The dashboard must read the CSV files that the stations produce.; R2: It must show a line chart of temperature for any chosen day.; R3: Users should be able to compare two stations on the same chart.
T3 [implement] Implement: The dashboard must flag readings that are missi… (requirements: R4; after: design) criteria: R4: The dashboard must flag readings that are missing for more than one hour.
T2 [test] Check: The dashboard must read the CSV files that the st… (+2) (requirements: R1, R2, R3; after: T1) criteria: R1 works as stated; R2 works as stated; R3 works as stated
T4 [test] Check: The dashboard must flag readings that are missing… (requirements: R4; after: T3) criteria: R4 works as stated
T5 [test] Check quality of the work (requirements: R5; after: T1, T3) criteria: R5: The dashboard must open in under five seconds for one month of data.
T6 [document] Write the README (requirements: -; after: T2, T4, T5) criteria: someone new can follow it; it matches the finished, tested work
review [review] Final review (requirements: -; after: T6) criteria: every must requirement is met; every deliverable is present; C1 respected: Use Python with pandas and matplotlib or Plotly.; D1 handed in: Dashboard submission
